about.headline: Meet NOVA
about.intro: NOVA is FlowDesktop's built-in AI assistant — designed to turn market data into clear, actionable insights through natural conversation. Whether you're analyzing a single stock, comparing sectors, or modeling macro impacts, NOVA brings institutional-grade analysis to every investor.
about.poweredBody: NOVA connects to the world's leading language models — OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, Alibaba Qwen, and MiniMax. In FlowDesktop AI mode, everything is managed for you. With BYOK, you connect your own key and pay your provider directly.
about.privacyBody: All conversation history is stored locally in your browser only — never on FlowDesktop servers. API keys are base64-encoded before storage and never leave your device. FlowDesktop does not see your chat content.
about.nameBody: NOVA stands for Networked Observational Value Analyst — a name that reflects how the assistant connects disparate market signals, observes patterns across thousands of stocks, and synthesises them into value-oriented insights for your portfolio.

pricing.faqTrialTitle: How does the free trial work?
pricing.faqTrialBody: You get 10 AI messages during your first 7 days — whichever limit is reached first ends the trial permanently. No credit card required.
pricing.faqByokTitle: Can I use my own API key?
pricing.faqByokBody: Yes — in Settings → AI Assistant, switch to "Use My Own Key" to connect your OpenAI, Anthropic, or other provider key. BYOK usage is not counted against any plan quota.
